title: refactor(plugin-chatbot): move ChatbotEnhanced types, subcomponents and helpers into chat/
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzSXwAvEjYZpZeyqoxsu2k7jv)_

Fixes #37728

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：没有。只把 `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 里的类型、子组件和工具函数搬到 `src/chat/` 下 7 个文件，不改行为。
- 为什么：删完 build 后这个文件还有 3335 行，后续对话体验改动都要改它；先拆开，降低冲突和审阅成本（专题 #37690 的拆分 A，拆分 B #37729 接着做）。
- 出问题会怎样：最坏是某个导入路径断了，类型检查和测试会直接红；回滚这一个合并即可。
- 需要你做的：改动行数 3870，超过 3000 行，按规则要授权账号批准或你亲手合并。

## What changes

A move-only split of `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: 3335 → 1514 lines. The file keeps the `ChatbotEnhanced` component, `formatMessageProps` and the two `PLAIN_SURFACE_*` constants, and re-exports by name (`export { … } from`, `export type { … } from`, no `export *`) every symbol it exported before. Every existing import path keeps working, so `FloatingChatbot`, `chatMessageAdapter`, `mapMessages`, `renderer`, `toolResultParsers`, `useAiModels`, `useHitlInChat` and the tests are untouched.

New modules under `src/chat/`, exactly as the card lists them:

| File | Symbols |
|:--|:--|
| `types.ts` | `ChatbotEnhancedMessage`, `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation`, `ChatChart`, `ChatSource`, `ChatbotLabels`, `ChatbotEnhancedProps`, `ChatbotProcessVisibility`, `ChatbotSurface`, `ChatbotModelOption`, `ToolDecisionState`, `TurnLiveness` |
| `ModelPicker.tsx` | `ModelPicker`, `drawnMultiplierOf`, `EXPENSIVE_MODEL_MULTIPLIER`, `OUTSIDE_MODELS` |
| `liveness.tsx` | `useTurnLiveness`, `LivenessIndicator`, `LIVENESS_QUIET_AFTER_SECONDS`, `useIsOffline`, `formatElapsed`, `ThinkingDots`, `AssistantThinkingMessage`, `MessageAvatar` |
| `toolSummary.tsx` | `getToolState`, `getToolStateRank`, `ToolSummaryState`, `ToolSummaryGroup`, `shouldRenderDetailedTool`, `summarizeTools`, `ToolPhaseSummary`, `ToolPhaseStep`, `foldToolPhaseSteps`, `isPlumbingTool`, `PLUMBING_TOOL_NAMES`, `ToolActivitySummary`, `ToolActivitySummaryLabels`, `ToolSummaryIcon`, `getToolSummaryStatus`, `ToolRunningTimer`, `usePhaseElapsed`, `phaseClock`, `SmartToolOutput`, `looksLikeJson` |
| `answerLayout.tsx` | `layoutAnswer`, `AnswerBlock`, `AnswerCharts`, `isToolCallPlaceholder` |
| `toolRecordWrite.ts` | `writtenRecordOf`, `formatRecordWriteValue` |
| `composerNotices.tsx` | `ErrorBanner`, `ComposerNotice`, `SendErrorNotice`, `formatSizeLimit`, `useAiQuotaCopy` |

Every top-level declaration of the old file is named in the card, so no private helper had to be placed by judgement and none stayed behind.

- **One `phaseClock`.** The module-level `Map` moved with `usePhaseElapsed` into `toolSummary.tsx`; there is no other copy.
- **Dependency direction.** `toolSummary → liveness` (`ToolRunningTimer` reads `useIsOffline` and `formatElapsed`), every module → `types`. No new module imports `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, and `types.ts` reaches `../mapMessages` with `import type` only.
- **Exports.** A moved symbol is exported from its new module only when another file uses it, or when the old file exported it.
- **Frozen entries.** `plugin-chatbot/src/index.tsx`, `plugin-chatbot/src/core.ts` and `app-shell/src/index.ts` have an empty diff.

The split was generated by a script that works from symbol names (TypeScript AST), not line numbers. It was first run on #37720's head and re-run on main after #37720 landed; the second run produced byte-identical files.

## Why

Card #37728, split A of topic #37690. Upcoming chat changes (feedback, approval cards, a thinking timeline) all land in this file; split B (#37729) moves `renderToolDetail` next and builds on `toolRecordWrite.ts`.

## Verification

```
git diff --color-moved=zebra --stat origin/main..HEAD
 .changeset/37728-chatbot-enhanced-split-a.md       |   10 +
 ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx | 1901 +-------------------
 .../plugin-chatbot/src/chat/ModelPicker.tsx        |  219 +++
 .../plugin-chatbot/src/chat/answerLayout.tsx       |  107 ++
 .../plugin-chatbot/src/chat/composerNotices.tsx    |  237 +++
 ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/chat/liveness.tsx   |  300 +++
 .../plugin-chatbot/src/chat/toolRecordWrite.ts     |   35 +
 .../plugin-chatbot/src/chat/toolSummary.tsx        |  471 +++++
 ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/chat/types.ts       |  590 ++++++
 9 files changed, 2009 insertions(+), 1861 deletions(-)
```

The deleted lines and the added lines differ only in import/export lines: comparing the two multisets of the diff, what is not in both is import specifiers, the new re-export block, `export` added in front of moved declarations, and each new file's license header and one-paragraph module comment. Nothing else changed.

Readings on head `2ed21c64`, against main `6e8f6637`:

- `pnpm run type-check` in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `pnpm run build` in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/ packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/column-identity.ratchet.test.ts`: 70 files, 668 tests passed.
- eslint over `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` and `src/chat/`: 0 errors, 9 warnings. Before the split the file had 2 warnings (one `react-refresh/only-export-components`, one `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect`). The 7 new ones are all `react-refresh/only-export-components`: the card's layout puts components and helpers in the same modules (for example `liveness.tsx` exports `formatElapsed` beside `ThinkingDots`). It is a fast-refresh hint, no gate counts warnings, and splitting further would leave the card's layout.
- dispatch-gates, all 32 derived commands: exit 0, including `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (which covers `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273`), `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check:test-source-alias`. Also `pnpm check:changeset-fixed`, `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0.
- `overlap-check`: merges cleanly with main, no open PR shares a file.

Changeset: `.changeset/37728-chatbot-enhanced-split-a.md`, `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, with both declaration lines.
